test_command: typst compile propuesta-smarttemp.typ propuesta-smarttemp.pdf && test -f propuesta-smarttemp.pdf
verification_instructions: Run typst compile on the .typ file and verify it produces a valid PDF without errors
snapshot_or_generated_files: propuesta-smarttemp.pdf is the generated output, not checked in
setup_instructions: typst CLI v0.15.1 already installed at /root/.cargo/bin/typst
environment_constraints: Amazon Linux 2023, typst 0.15.1 installed via cargo. Network available for font/package downloads if needed.
key_patterns: The source HTML has 6 pages: cover, features+TERMO, schema+specs, applications, pricing plans, advantages+contact. Brand color #29b6f6, sans-serif fonts, feature cards with colored left borders, pricing tables with dark headers.
directory_structure: Root contains only propuesta-smarttemp.html. The .typ file and any index.html will be created at root level.
